highlights: The AI model landscape is rapidly expanding with domain-specific frontier models like Google's Gemini 4 Carbon for cyber defense and Samaya AI's cost-efficient Sterling for finance, alongside open-source advancements in multi-lingual speech transcription.

Significant progress in AI agent development focuses on building robust and reliable systems, including new frameworks for adaptable agent training, automated web environments, and critical insights into ensuring intent alignment in sensitive applications like smart contract synthesis.

Major AI players are solidifying enterprise adoption through key partnerships with industry giants like ServiceNow and Oracle, while also addressing critical ethical and data governance issues for AI model training.

agents.title: Samaya AI Releases Sterling: A 3B-Active Finance Research Agent Model that Beats Claude Fable 5.1 on FrontierFinance at 11x Lower Cost
agents.summary: Samaya AI released Sterling, a financial research agent model (based on Nemotron 3.5 Lightning) that significantly outperforms Claude Fable 5.1 on financial benchmarks at an 11x lower cost, enabling highly efficient and accurate financial analysis for builders.

agents.title: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
agents.summary: WebAnything is a fully automated framework that reconstructs source-grounded, reusable web environments from real URLs, providing scalable and diverse executable settings for training and evaluating AI agents without manual per-site engineering.

agents.title: Measuring Where Intent Gets Lost in Agentic Smart Contract Synthesis
agents.summary: This research introduces an execution-based evaluation and an elicitation-first architecture for AI-written smart contracts, crucially identifying where intent is lost and proposing methods to ensure desired behavior in critical, immutable applications.

models.title: Google DeepMind Introduces Gemini 4 Carbon, Its Top Model for Cyber Defense and Coding
models.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier model excelling in cyber defense and coding, offering high performance for vetted cyber defenders and developers at competitive token costs for specialized applications.

models.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: An Open 30B MoE Model for 40-Language Transcription with ~4B Active Parameters
models.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open 30B MoE model with ~4B active parameters, providing high-accuracy, 40-language speech transcription with speaker labels and word timestamps, ideal for building advanced voice applications.

models.title: Welcome Le Chonk: Mistral Large 4 on Hugging Face
models.summary: Hugging Face announced the availability of Mistral Large 4, a significant new model from Mistral AI, making a powerful general-purpose LLM accessible for various applications and research on the Hugging Face platform.

tools.title: Prime Intellect Releases Prime Mega MoE: Trainable Fused MoE Kernel, 3.11x Faster Forward Pass
tools.summary: Prime Intellect released Prime Mega MoE, a trainable fused MoE kernel that dramatically accelerates the backward pass for MoE model training, improving forward pass speed by 3.11x and overall training efficiency for large-scale models.

tools.title: Infini-AI-Lab Releases Hermit, an Open-Source Harness Adapter Framework for AI Agents
tools.summary: Infini-AI-Lab launched Hermit, an open-source Apache-2.0 harness adapter framework that allows AI agents to learn instructions, skills, memory, and tools from task feedback by training an external layer, enhancing agent adaptability without modifying the core model.

tools.title: Hugging Face ❤️ TorchTPU: TPUs, Natively
tools.summary: Hugging Face announced native support for TorchTPU, enabling developers to leverage Google's Tensor Processing Units directly on the platform for highly efficient training and inference of deep learning models, particularly for large-scale AI research and deployment.

companies.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
companies.summary: OpenAI and ServiceNow expanded their partnership to integrate OpenAI models and agents deeply into ServiceNow workflows, streamlining enterprise processes and bringing advanced AI capabilities to a broader business audience.

companies.title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
companies.summary: OpenAI expanded its partnership with Oracle, aiming to integrate Oracle's business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT while powering new Oracle offerings, significantly broadening the reach and utility of OpenAI's models across the enterprise ecosystem.

companies.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
companies.summary: OpenAI introduced a shared `robots.txt` signal to allow website operators to express their AI training preferences, setting a crucial precedent for data governance and giving publishers more control over how their content is used by participating AI providers.

learning.title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
learning.summary: Google launched "Mapping the human brain," its newest AI Quest lesson on neuroscience, offering an accessible educational opportunity for individuals to enhance their AI literacy through practical applications.

learning.title: OpenFrontiers: A Collection of Open Research Problems and a Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery
learning.summary: OpenFrontiers is a new cross-disciplinary resource and benchmark designed to evaluate and measure LLM agents' capabilities in solving research-level problems and scientific rediscovery, providing a critical tool for advancing AI research and education.

learning.title: Announcing Project ProtoStar: Making Publicly Funded Science AI-Ready
learning.summary: Hugging Face announced Project ProtoStar, an initiative focused on making publicly funded scientific data AI-ready, facilitating greater accessibility for AI research, development, and learning within the scientific community.
